LEGACY-AI-UTF8-001.requiredDecision: Record an explicitly reviewed host transport deviation to use a streaming decoder, or document an approved temporary compatibility policy. The R0 observed corruption fixture does not approve reproducing this defect in Rust.

parameters: payload: AnswerApplyPayload & { operationId?: string; documentId?: string; expiresAt?: number }
returnExpressions:
Array.from(element.querySelectorAll('.num_option, .num_option_dx, [role="radio"], [role="checkbox"], input[type="radio"], input[type="checkbox"]'))
    .some((child) => selectedClassHit(child as HTMLElement) ||
      child.getAttribute('aria-checked') === 'true' ||
      child.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' ||
      ((child as HTMLInputElement).checked === true))

cleanText(
    marker?.getAttribute('data') ||
    marker?.getAttribute('value') ||
    input?.value ||
    element.getAttribute('data') ||
    element.getAttribute('value') ||
    ''
  )

parseJudgementValueStable([
    element.getAttribute('data'),
    marker?.getAttribute('data'),
    element.getAttribute('value'),
    marker?.getAttribute('value'),
    input?.value,
    element.getAttribute('aria-label'),
    visibleText(element)
  ].filter(Boolean).join(' '))
payload?.operationId ? { ...result, sessionId: payload.sessionId, operationId: payload.operationId, targetTabId: payload.targetTabId, documentId: webDocumentId } : result

repairMojibakeText(String(text || ''))
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    // 行首编号剥离：顿号/括号类分隔符可直接剥离；点号分隔符要求后跟非数字，
    // 避免把小数“1.5倍速”“3.14”剥成“5倍速”“14”
    .replace(/^\s*\d{1,3}\s*(?:[、．)]|\.(?!\d))/, '')
    .trim()

{

        left: rect.left,
        height: rect.height
      }

{
    label,
    text: optionLabel(label, displayText || rawText || label),
    selector: selectorFor(element),
    inputSelector: input ? selectorFor(input) : undefined,
    clickSelector: clickTarget !== element ? selectorFor(clickTarget) : undefined,
    value: dataValue || undefined
  }

pageRequests.release: Single asynchronous reply. Click after 180ms; poll every 250ms for at most 7000ms. Full-preview final page returns done:true; no submit action.
returnExpressions:
/全卷预览|整卷预览|答题卡|提交试卷|交卷|保存并提交/.test(text) &&
    !document.querySelector('.singleQuestionDiv .nextDiv a')

repairMojibakeText(String(text || ''))
    .replace(/ /g, ' ')
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    // 行首编号剥离：顿号/括号类分隔符可直接剥离；点号分隔符要求后跟非数字，
    // 避免把小数“1.5倍速”“3.14”剥成“5倍速”“14”
    .replace(/^\s*\d{1,3}\s*(?:[、．)]|\.(?!\d))/, '')
    .trim()
{ success: true, done: false, message: '已切换到下一题。' }
{ success: true, done: true, message: '已进入全卷浏览。' }
